atoms.text: Northern Ireland is the smallest country within the United Kingdom. The capital city of Northern Ireland is Belfast.

atoms.a: During the Industrial Revolution in the 19th century, Belfast was the leading producer of linen.
Another major industry in Belfast was shipbuilding. The famous passenger ship “RMS Titanic” was built there. There are still shipyards in Belfast today.

hint.text: shipyard – Werft (Ort, an dem Schiffe gebaut und repariert werden)

atoms.text: The “Giant's Causeway” is one of many UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Around 60 million years ago, there were volcanic eruptions in Northern Ireland. The lava cooled down and transformed into hexagonal shapes. They are up to 12 m high. There's a legend that says that the “Giant's Causeway” was made by Fionn Mac Cumhaill, a giant who fought against another giant from Scotland, called Benandonner.

trainers.finishSound: Hey Bram! Have you ever been to Northern Ireland? I explored the Giant's Causeway a few days ago. A legend says that it was built by a giant, but it was actually caused by a volcanic eruption. I'm quite excited for tomorrow because it's the last day of the Irish Language Week. It's a festival which promotes the Irish language and culture. See you next week! Evan.
